verdict.rationale: Mercury offers some recurring, automation-like features (automatic invoices, AI-powered bill-pay automations, auto-funding rules for accounts) but there is no evidence of a general-purpose scheduler or 'recurring job/workflow' API, CLI command, or MCP tool that an AI-native user could invoke to schedule arbitrary tasks. The MCP server is explicitly read-only (31 get/list tools) and the CLI/API expose transactional resources, not job scheduling. Missing for 10: dedicated recurring-job/cron API or MCP tool, evidence of scheduling arbitrary workflows beyond built-in invoice/bill automations, and any documentation of a scheduler for AI agents.
